business_problem: As global AI talent communities are growing rapidly, DINQ needed to support increasing real-time collaboration and high engagement while delivering a consistent user experience across international markets. From a technology standpoint, the platform had to handle traffic fluctuations caused by community activities and launches, while maintaining low-latency AI-driven matching at scale. Also, stable WebSocket connections across regions were essential to ensure fast iteration with reliable CI/CD pipelines.
